title: Governance Approval Submission
description: Untrusted ingress command for submitting approval, adjudication, cosignature, risk-acceptance, cancellation, withdrawal, or quorum-participation content to AGCP. The submission carries claimant-provided content and provenance only. It is not a Governance Approval Artifact, does not establish verification, eligibility, quorum completion, lifecycle effect, Canonical State qualification, authority, ledger ordering, or permission to execute.
$comment: DS-045 is the authoritative submission schema for IF-001 governance-approval ingress. The AGCP implementation SHALL validate and independently qualify the submission before creating or qualifying DS-026 Governance Approval Artifact evidence. Server-derived fields such as approval_artifact_id, status, approver_eligibility, lifecycle_state_binding, canonical_state_ref_at_adjudication, authority_lineage_ref, governance_evidence_refs, cryptographic_verification, replay_protection, artifact_digest, semantic_assertions, lifecycle_effect, artifact_termination, and computed quorum state are intentionally absent and rejected by additionalProperties:false.
x-agcp-schema-role: Governance Approval Submission — Untrusted Ingress Command

namespaced_extensions.description: Namespace-qualified claimant extensions. Extensions SHALL NOT assert AGCP verification, qualification, lifecycle, authority, quorum, evidence, or ledger results.

quorum_claim.description: Claimant-declared quorum association only. Threshold, eligibility, distinct-principal checks, sequence, counted status, accumulated count, and completion status are server-derived and are not accepted here.

claimed_approver.description: Claimant-provided approver identity assertion. AGCP SHALL bind it to authenticated identity and current qualified authority before accepting it.

client_submission_id.description: Client correlation identifier only; it is not an authoritative approval-artifact identifier or ledger identifier.

submitted_at.description: Claimant-declared submission time. It is not authoritative issuance, verification, ordering, or lifecycle time.

provenance.description: Claimant provenance protecting the submission. Successful provenance verification is recorded separately in the authoritative DS-026 artifact and Governance Evidence.
